description: This file contains Kotlin code defining a data class `ParsedInvokeError` and functions to parse error messages. It handles parsing error strings to extract codes and messages, and provides a way to construct a `ParsedInvokeError` from a Throwable object.

classes.name: ParsedInvokeError
classes.description: A data class representing a parsed invoke error with code, message, and a flag indicating if an explicit code was provided.

methods.name: parseInvokeErrorMessage
methods.description: Parses a raw error string to extract an error code and message, returning a ParsedInvokeError object.

methods.name: parseInvokeErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Creates a ParsedInvokeError from a Throwable, using its message or a fallback string.
